translations.web: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
translations.bsb: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
translations.kjv: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
translations.asv: Herein I also exercise myself to have a conscience void of offence toward God and men always.
